parameters.name: FNL_ELEV
parameters.help: Enter final datum elevation constant value or PARAMETER from the SRF GEOMETRY DataBase. See help for other suggestions.

parameters.name: REPL_VEL
parameters.help: Enter replacement velocity constant value or PARAMETER from the SRF GEOMETRY DataBase. See help for other suggestions.

parameters.name: METHOD
parameters.help: Select the method used for database math.  This will create the statics that are actually applied.

parameters.name: W_VELOC
parameters.help: Enter groups of STATION-Weathering Velocity values. **SEE EXAMPLE!!!**

parameters.name: MATHFILE
parameters.help: This specifies the name of the file that is used for database math to generate elevation statics.

parameters.name: NMO_METH
parameters.help: Select the method for creating the NMO statics.  See the help file for more explanation.

choices.label: Elevations
choices.help: Use the smoothed surface elevations (NMO datum).

choices.label: Mean Statics
choices.help: Use the smoothed mean of source and receiver statics of contributing traces in a CDP.

parameters.name: NSMOOTH
parameters.help: Enter the length of the smoother (in CDPs).  Use an odd number.

parameters.name: DATUM
parameters.help: Select datum for processing.  See the help file for more explanation.

choices.label: FINAL DATUM
choices.help: Apply statics to FINAL DATUM. NMO_DATUM = FINAL DATUN, C_STATIC = 0
